scope: Static host-only equal-member ballots in explicitly authorized local or regional scopes
inputs: canonical electorate and unique eligible ballots
exact proposed policy binding and target
reviewed policy registry and direct jurisdiction
canonical dated administrative participation claims and shared work precedence
procedure: Resolve authority using WP-013; require the exact proposal to be selected. Allocate shared administrative time through DOM-02. Require complete administrative claims. Count submitted known ballots, including abstentions, toward quorum and approval denominator; strict majority requires more than half yes, unanimity requires every submitted ballot yes.
independent_oracle: Two yes and one no approve by strict majority and reject under unanimity. Five hours with three administrative hours first leave two of four care hours fulfilled; care first leaves only one administrative hour and blocks completion.

ports.authority: Shared world jurisdiction and policy binding/resolution services
ports.administration: Actual DOM-02 participation consuming canonical cohort time alongside care/work/training
ports.evidence: Detached full input, policy findings and shared allocation accounts/claims/postings

No behavioral legitimacy or social effects

No queues, stages, disclosure delay, effective times or transitions
